Author: Viper
Name: Auto Adjusting Simple Heels
Punchline: Adjust the position of your character model. Now able to auto adjust off character scale!
Description:
Adjust the position of your character model. Now able to auto adjust off character scale!

Commands:
/heels
/heels toggle
/heels enable
/heels disable
/heels temp
/heels renamechar "<source char name>|<source world>" "<target char name>|<target world>"

This build shares its config with the official Simple Heels plugin.
Originally created by Caraxi.
